usedFor: Contacts+ holds your contacts and tags, and MailerLite receives them as subscribers through “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a business card is transcribed” in Contacts+, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A transcribed business card becomes a subscriber, and an existing one is updated rather than duplicated.

watchOut: “When a contact is updated” in Contacts+ runs on every edit, so one person reaches MailerLite many times.
